entities.summary: Vonn Christian Bell is an American professional football safety who currently serves as the safeties coach for the Colorado Buffaloes. He played college football for the Ohio State Buckeyes and was selected by the New Orleans Saints in the second round of the 2016 NFL draft. He also played for the Cincinnati Bengals and Carolina Panthers.
